# NudoIQ

> NudoIQ is an independent Chrome extension for Amazon Relay carriers. It adds
> load alerts, booking rules, lane rate intelligence, truck routing, fleet
> reporting, and printable driver pay statements on top of the Amazon Relay
> load board. Built for owner-operators, dispatchers, and small fleets.

NudoIQ is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Amazon.com, Inc.
Carriers remain responsible for their own accounts and for compliance with
Amazon Relay's terms of service.

## What it does

- **Load alerts** — notifies you when a matching load is posted or changes price, so you do not have to watch the board continuously.
- **Booking rules** — filters and limits that control what gets searched, alerted on, or auto-booked.
- **Lane Intelligence** — compares a posted rate against recent observations and shows a target rate, a likely range, and a clearly marked confidence level.
- **Bid Advisor** — when posting a truck, compares your bid against the current board median, the highest visible rate, and the historical floor, median and ceiling for that lane, shown in dollars per mile.
- **Scorecard dispute letters** — reads your Amazon Relay scorecard, identifies the violations behind the score, and drafts an Amazon policy-based dispute letter for you to review, edit and submit. Amazon decides every dispute outcome.
- **Truck routing** — a truck-appropriate route preview before you accept a load.
- **Driver dispatch** — sends trip details to a driver by email or text on assignment.
- **HOS overview** — available hours and warnings before committing to the next load.
- **Fleet reporting** — revenue, miles, fuel, margin, drivers, and trips in one dashboard, with CSV import.
- **Driver pay statements** — turns completed trips into a printable or PDF pay statement.
- **Bilingual interface** — full English and Spanish, switchable.

## Pricing

One plan at $49.99 per month, with a 7-day free trial. A payment method is
required to start the trial. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid the first
charge. No annual contract.

## Requirements

Chrome or another Chromium-based browser (Edge, Brave). NudoIQ runs in the
browser, so the Amazon Relay tab and the computer must stay available while it
watches the load board.

## Important limitations

NudoIQ does not guarantee rates, load availability, bookings, time savings, or
earnings. Rate estimates and the value calculator on the website are planning
aids, not promises. Figures shown in product screenshots are illustrative
examples with identifying data removed.
